focus_area: Agent discovery and deployment cost optimization
recommendation: Design cost-efficient initialization through warm pools and caching
guidance: Cold starts are a significant per-invocation cost in agent infrastructure, where model loading, tool registration, and memory hydration run on every fresh session. You can reduce those per-invocation costs through persistent filesystems, session affinity, and lazy context loading to reuse results while still scaling to zero for agents that are rarely called.
how_to_check: • You amortize initialization costs across many invocations by caching artifacts on a persistent filesystem. • You have frequently invoked agents reusing warm sessions and infrequent agents scaling to zero without idle charges. • You defer non-essential context retrieval to on-demand, keeping initialization under a fixed time budget. • You track cold start rates and initialization costs per agent type. For more information, see the AGENTCOST06-BP03 documentation.
